title: BUGFIX — Fix stale Block E publishing assertions (Blotato 9-platform era)
rationale: validate-publishing-output.ts had three stale assertions written before Blotato multi-platform was added. (1) published.length === passedGates.length — now fails because Blotato produces 9 PublishedVideo entries per QC-passed video (one per platform). Fixed to published.length === passedGates.length * 9. (2) validPlatforms was ['tiktok', 'instagram_reels', 'youtube_shorts'] — TikTok-era 3-platform list. Blotato uses 9 different names: 'instagram', 'youtube', 'tiktok', 'facebook', 'linkedin', 'threads', 'x', 'pinterest', 'bluesky'. Fixed to all 9. (3) Same published.length === passedGates.length on line 101 (Block E integrity check). Fixed identically.

tasks.description: In scripts/scs001/validate-publishing-output.ts: (1) line 55: replace published.length === passedGates.length with published.length === passedGates.length * 9 with comment. (2) line 60: replace validPlatforms 3-platform list with all 9 Blotato platforms. (3) line 101: same fix as (1) for Block E integrity check.
